title: Crispy Spring Roll
description: Crispy Spring Roll - These spring rolls are light and very crisp with savory beef and vegetable fillings. You can read my spring roll sheet story here.

steps.text: Preheat the 2 tablespoons of Oil in the pan and saute the Onion and scallion until it's translucent then add the Chili pepper, black Pepper, Curry powder, salt to taste and the stock cube.

raw.text: Preheat the 2 tablespoons of Oil in the pan and saute the Onion and scallion until it's translucent then add the Chili pepper, black Pepper, Curry powder, salt to taste and the stock cube.
raw.name: Preheat the 2 tablespoons of Oil in the pan and saute the Onion and scallion until it's translucent then add the Chili pepper, black Pepper, Curry powder, salt to taste and the stock cube.

steps.text: Add the ground beef and use a wooden spoon or spatula to break it up into tiny pieces then stir-fry until the meat is cooked through then add the shredded cabbage and carrots and turn off the heat to prevent the vegetables from turning soggy and leave it to cool before using it.

raw.text: Add the ground beef and use a wooden spoon or spatula to break it up into tiny pieces then stir-fry until the meat is cooked through then add the shredded cabbage and carrots and turn off the heat to prevent the vegetables from turning soggy and leave it to cool before using it.
raw.name: Add the ground beef and use a wooden spoon or spatula to break it up into tiny pieces then stir-fry until the meat is cooked through then add the shredded cabbage and carrots and turn off the heat to prevent the vegetables from turning soggy and leave it to cool before using it.

steps.text: In a bowl, mix together the flour and Water to make the paste and set that aside.

raw.text: In a bowl, mix together the flour and Water to make the paste and set that aside.
raw.name: In a bowl, mix together the flour and Water to make the paste and set that aside.

steps.text: Add about 1 tablespoon of filling to the spring roll sheet you can add a little more depending on the size of your sheets but don't overfill it, else, it's going to burst while frying it, then secure it with the paste and roll it up. (please watch the video for details). Remember to cover both the rolled and unrolled sheets with a damp kitchen towel to prevent it from drying.

steps.text: Fry in a preheated Oil of about 350°F until golden brown. Serve with your favorite dip or sauce or eat as is. Enjoy!
